name: supabase-tools
description: Portable toolkit for local Supabase development: Docker services, migrations, snapshots, ERD, tests, and docs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/sdk && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.test: vitest run --config packages/core/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-erd/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-typegen/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-db-test/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-depgraph/vitest.config.ts
